params.text: Sets how long the envelope takes to rise to its peak, 1ms at one end of its travel and 10 seconds at the other
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from the peak to the sustain level, 1ms at one end of its travel and 10 seconds at the other
Sets the level held while the gate stays up, 0% to 100% of the full 10V
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall back to 0V after the gate drops, 1ms at one end of its travel and 10 seconds at the other

inputs.text: The envelope rises while the voltage here is 1V or more and falls once it drops below that
A rise here starts the attack again without the gate having to drop first

notes: The envelope output carries no channels until something is patched to gate, so with gate empty the module puts out nothing at all
